_recorded: 2026-08-26, qwen/qwen3.6-35b-a3b via LM Studio over the tailnet, after the scoring fixes and the dismissal-grounding rules
_how: Full mode was run twice at 5 repeats and scored 0.886 and 0.914 accuracy, with agreement 0.843 and 0.971. The baseline records the LOWEST of each, not the best: anything above is within observed variance, and a floor set at the best run would fail on ordinary sampling. Raise it only when a change is understood to have made the system better, never to turn a red run green.
_note_on_false_negatives: The gate fails on any false negative regardless of this baseline, and deliberately so — it is the one outcome that should always stop the line.
